name: Spell Menu
description: Lets the item's user cast one of several possible spells from it.

mechanics.text: On activation, casts one of a menu of predetermined spells. Which spells (names and any per-spell charge cost), and the item's own save DC if it has one, live entirely in this record's own featureParams — the same 'compound fact stays together' reasoning as feat.cast-a-spell, extended to a whole menu instead of one fixed spell. Mirrors how a monster's own Multiattack references its other attacks rather than being its own attack.
